articles.title: Letter: The Accessible Ramp on Eaton Road Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
To the editor: I have lived on Eaton Road for 28 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the March meeting. Please keep the accessible ramp in the budget. Many of us on Eaton Road use it every week.
Arthur Beaudry, Eastgate
